persistence of the added bin across a reload — deliberately not asserted; the repo's waitForAutoSave() cannot distinguish the pre-bin empty-layout save from the post-bin save (planner D10), and persistence is outside the frozen B-S1 outcome
any server-side write path for adding a bin — none exists; no HTTP request is produced by the action, so V4 write proof is N/A rather than verified

the bundled preflight validator's 'reachable' verdict for the approved origin — unobtainable here because Vite binds only ::1 (localhost peer disagreement, curl exit 7 on 127.0.0.1) and the helper's --resolve form for a bracketed IPv6 literal is rejected by curl 8.7.1 (exit 49); reachability was instead proven by a pinned no-proxy no-redirect probe returning HTTP 200 on ::1

off_origin_details: no off-origin action was initiated by the agent; the application's own load-time requests to https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono... and https://va.vercel-scripts.com/v1/script.debug.js were aborted pre-dispatch by the exploration route guard (evidence that the guard was active), and were neither stubbed nor repaired
